svg.title: Ragged regions — 039 / After the weights reveal — Reader
svg.desc: Fog of war, Ragged regions: 039 / After the weights reveal, Reader. Schematic drawn claim terrain; P1 hatched; P2 dark; P3 dark; P4 dark; P5 hatched. P1 outer foothold dark. Observation islands: response hatched, correction hatched, configuration hatched, weights hatched. P6 remains dark and unreachable. Dark means no available support, not false. Contours remain fixed across fixtures. Design sample, not adopted. Shaded relief with a soft, irregular fog edge; unexplored ground is opaque, ground that lost support stays dimly visible. Many pictograms lie draped on the ground beneath the fog, not text; a key names them outside the map.
svg.text: SYMBOLS LIE ON THE GROUND, UNDER THE FOG
THE GROUND REMAINS. P2 RE-FOGS; P1 LOSES ITS OUTER FOOTHOLD.
039.3,5–6 / injection reading; OAI-BH weights channel; unresolved conflict · OUR INFERENCE / SCHEMATIC RELIEF / FOG IS COMPUTED, NOT MEASURED
